name: taskeya
description: Manage Taskeya projects, tasks, comments, activity and report drafts within your permissions. No invoice, billing, purchasing, payment, HR, salary or payroll access. Explain these limits without calling Taskeya tools for unsupported requests.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Taskeya account to find tasks, review assigned work, and summarize activity and project metrics. Get clear results with project and task names, people’s first names, task links, and tables or charts when useful. Create or update tasks, add comments, archive explicitly selected tasks, and create projects or boards within your existing permissions and organization policy. Sign in and connect: all projects you can access are included by default, with no project-selection setup. Prepare task changes, report drafts, and project or board deletions for review in Taskeya. This version does not provide HR, payroll, billing, purchasing, or payment actions.
defaultPrompt: What work is assigned to me in Taskeya?
Find a task and summarize its latest activity.
Help me create a task in Taskeya.

positive.description: Use the dedicated reviewer organization with assigned sample tasks in Plugin Review and Marketing Campaign. Connect with default access to all permitted projects.
positive.prompt: What work is assigned to me in Taskeya?
positive.expected_behavior: Read the connected organization and get_my_work. Summarize only returned tasks using linked task names, project names, people first names, and available dates. Include assigned tasks in all accessible projects. Do not display database IDs or include inaccessible private project tasks; do not claim a partial page is complete.

positive.description: In an authorized project named Plugin Review, create a task named Prepare launch checklist. No other task should contain that exact name.
positive.prompt: Find Prepare launch checklist in Plugin Review and show its latest activity.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Plugin Review with list_projects. Search using query=Prepare launch checklist and the returned project_id. Read the matched task and its activity using the returned task_id. Report only returned activity; say if the activity list is empty. Use the project and task names in the response, not database IDs.

positive.description: The reviewer account may create and update tasks. Organization policy permits task writes. Sign in and connect using default project access; no project-selection step is required. This case writes sample data.
positive.prompt: Create a task called Review plugin onboarding in Plugin Review. Then rename that new task to Review ChatGPT onboarding.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the project and board from returned data. Use create_tasks with one tasks entry containing project_id, board_id and task.name, plus an idempotency_key. Read that task to obtain its current version. Use update_tasks for that exact item_id with changes.name and expected_version, using a new idempotency_key. Report per-task results and verify the final name with get_task. Never describe a failed or pending action as completed.

positive.description: Use the sample task Prepare launch checklist. Grant comments.write and enable autonomous writes. This case adds a visible sample comment.
positive.prompt: Add this comment to Prepare launch checklist: The plugin review checklist is ready.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the task within authorized projects, then call add_task_comments with its project_id and item_id, content exactly The plugin review checklist is ready., and an idempotency_key. Confirm success only when the returned operation status indicates completion.

positive.description: The reviewer account may archive tasks; grant tasks.archive and enable autonomous writes. Create one sample task called Archive this plugin sample in Plugin Review.
positive.prompt: Archive only Archive this plugin sample in Plugin Review.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the single named sample task, obtain its current version with get_task, and call archive_tasks with that project_id, item_id, expected_version, and an idempotency_key. Archive only the explicitly named task and report the returned execution result.

negative.description: Payments are unsupported. Explain the limit without invoking any Taskeya mutation tool or claiming that a payment was made.
negative.prompt: Use Taskeya to pay our supplier invoice with my credit card.

negative.description: HR and payroll are outside this plugin tool set. Explain the limit without invoking unrelated tools or claiming to retrieve salary data.
negative.prompt: Show every employee salary and approve this month’s payroll in Taskeya.

negative.description: Time tracking is not exposed by this plugin. Explain that starting timers and writing time entries are unsupported, without calling Taskeya tools, creating substitute tasks/comments, or claiming a timer started. Taskeya project/task access remains available.
negative.prompt: Start the Taskeya time tracker for Prepare launch checklist in Plugin Review.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. It connects to an existing Taskeya account.

publication.release_notes: Separated task creation and task updates into distinct tools with explicit schemas. Corrected annotations for proposal replacement, comment delivery and workspace-bounded actions. Clarified notifications, external webhooks and approval requirements. All 23 tools have four explicit boolean hints and behavior-based justifications in tool-annotations.json, verified through OAuth tool discovery.

ar.subtitle: أدِر عمل فريقك
ar.description: اربط حسابك في تاسكيا للبحث عن المهام ومراجعة العمل المسند إليك وتلخيص النشاط ومؤشرات مساحات العمل. احصل على نتائج واضحة بأسماء مساحات العمل والمهام والأسماء الأولى للأشخاص وروابط المهام والجداول أو الرسوم البيانية عند الحاجة. أنشئ المهام وحدّثها وأضف التعليقات وأرشف المهام المحددة وأنشئ مساحات عمل أو لوحات ضمن صلاحياتك الحالية وسياسة المؤسسة. سجّل الدخول واربط حسابك: تُضمّن افتراضيًا جميع مساحات العمل التي يمكنك الوصول إليها دون الحاجة إلى اختيارها. جهّز تغييرات المهام ومسودات التقارير وطلبات حذف مساحات العمل أو اللوحات للمراجعة في تاسكيا. لا يوفر هذا الإصدار إجراءات الموارد البشرية أو الرواتب أو الفوترة أو الشراء أو الدفع.
